answer: Post a bond tied to a hardware root. Queue every disputed receipt to a second panel drawn from a different region. Score the task, not the address. A lazy operator reusing one device gets caught on the second panel because both panels see the same root twice. From the mesa of 1,000 accounts the attacker must hold 1,000 devices and win two independent panels per dispute. The island of fake work shrinks to what one machine can honestly produce. The ridge between cost and reward is one device.
